rso.narration.scrollbar.usage.vertical: Press Up or Down to scroll
rso.narration.scrollbar.usage.horizontal: Press Left or Right to scroll
rso.options.enabled.name: Enable Reese's Sodium Options
rso.options.enabled.tooltip: Replaces Sodium's options screen with Reese's Sodium Options. When disabled, Sodium's default screen is shown instead. Applying this option reopens the screen.
rso.options.tab_header_icons.name: Tab Header Icons
rso.options.tab_header_icons.tooltip: Controls whether mod icons are shown in tab headers.
rso.options.tab_header_version_labels.to: Controls whether mod version labels are shown in tab headers.
rso.options.tab_header_collapse_mode.too: Controls how mod tab headers expand and collapse in the sidebar.
rso.options.tab_headers.name: Tab Headers
rso.options.tab_headers.tooltip: Shows mod tab header rows when Tab Header Collapse Mode is set to All Expanded.
Shows single-page mods as only their tab header instead of also showing a page tab.
rso.options.collapsible_groups.name: Collapsible Groups
rso.options.collapsible_groups.tooltip: Makes option group headers within a page clickable to collapse or expand the options beneath them.
rso.options.tooltip_delay.name: Tooltip Delay
rso.options.tooltip_delay.tooltip: Controls how long an option must be hovered before its tooltip is shown.
rso.options.tooltip_option_ids.name: Tooltip Option Identifiers
rso.options.tooltip_option_ids.tooltip: Shows option identifiers at the top of option tooltips.
rso.options.color_themes.name: Color Themes
rso.options.color_themes.tooltip: Controls whether tab buttons, option controls, and tooltip borders use each mod's color theme.
rso.options.themed_headers_and_labels.to: Applies each mod's color theme to tab headers, mod icons, and option group labels.
rso.options.themed_tooltip_borders.name: Themed Tooltip Borders
rso.options.themed_tooltip_borders.toolt: Applies each mod's color theme to option tooltip borders.
rso.options.reduced_motion.name: Reduced Motion
rso.options.reduced_motion.tooltip: Disables animated tab header text scrolling and cursor fading.
rso.options.reverse_cycling_controls.too: Allows right-clicking cycling controls to move backward through values.
rso.options.shift_scroll_slider_adjustme: Allows scrolling over sliders while holding Shift to adjust their values.
rso.options.search_result_limit.name: Search Result Limit
rso.options.search_result_limit.tooltip: Controls the maximum number of matching options returned by search.
rso.options.hide_non_matching_options.to: Hides options that do not match the active search query.
rso.options.hide_non_matching_tabs.name: Hide Non-Matching Tabs
rso.options.hide_non_matching_tabs.toolt: Hides tabs that do not contain options matching the active search query.
rso.options.disabled_option_visibility.t: Controls whether disabled options stay visible or are hidden from option lists.
rso.options.focus_border_mode.name: Focus Border Mode
rso.options.focus_border_mode.tooltip: Controls when keyboard focus borders are drawn around focused controls.
rso.options.controller_guides.name: Controller Guides
rso.options.controller_guides.tooltip: Shows controller button hints in the footer when using a controller.
rso.options.reset_button_overlay.name: Reset Button Overlay
rso.options.reset_button_overlay.tooltip: Shows the reset-to-default button on options whose current value differs from the default.
rso.options.undo_button_overlay.name: Undo Button Overlay
rso.options.undo_button_overlay.tooltip: Shows an undo button on changed options to restore their applied value.
rso.options.always_show_action_buttons.t: Keeps reset and undo buttons visible when their overlay is enabled, drawing unavailable actions as disabled.
rso.options.support_project.name: Support the project via Ko-fi
rso.options.support_project.tooltip: Opens FlashyReese's Ko-fi page in your browser.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.reeses-so: Replaces Sodium's Options Screen with intention of improving UX
